input.checkpoint_normalization: State/action q01/q99 quantile statistics from physical-intelligence/libero; state is padded to 32. Quantile normalization does not guarantee all out-of-distribution values lie in [-1,1].
input.processor_images: PIL BILINEAR aspect-preserving resize 640x480 to 224x168, vertical pad28+28, then float32 NCHW /255*2-1
input.H5_reader_branch: Separate OpenCV INTER_AREA stretch to256x256 CHW uint8; ACT/DP reader float /255. Not an intermediate in pi05 RPC input.

task_text.expected_canonical_source: Current environment get_task_language() -> observation.task_language -> Pi05LiberoAdapter.encode_observation -> wire task_descriptions; each live request saves exact text in model/inference.jsonl
task_text.task_text: Pick the light cuvette from white rack slot A1 and transport it to the candidate_far_hinge internal seat of the single open instrument. Insert, transfer support, open both fingers, retreat and leave the vessel stable. The selected target is candidate_far_hinge, the internal seat farther from the lid hinge among the two seats. Nominal task geometry: loading depth 27 mm, cuvette height 67.5 mm, and 40.5 mm of the cuvette remaining above the seat entrance at the nominal loaded pose. These are static configured task goals, not measurements of the current vessel pose, insertion depth or support. Static robot calibration: TCPpose is the world pose of frame right_gripper, not the panda_hand/palm origin. The fixed transform from right_gripper coordinates into parent frame panda_hand has translation [0.0, 0.0, 0.1] metres and quaternion [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0] in wxyz order. This 100 mm frame-origin separation is not the whole-hand collision envelope. Confirm clearance for the entire hand, fingers and held vessel in both camera views; this fixed robot calibration provides no current object or obstacle pose, safe height or motion path.

action_transfer.semantics: LIBERO OSC seven values after checkpoint unnormalize; adapter clips[-1,1], scales translation.05m/rotation.5rad, then per-axis caps.0005m/.004rad, robot-base vectors rotated toworld
action_transfer.gripper_semantics: value>.05 close; value<-.05 open; stateful single-finger target changes by .008m, clamped0..04; transmitted total opening0..08m
action_transfer.chunk_semantics: Execute sequentially against actual preceding successor; reject/partial/termination discards remainder. No automatic chunk replay or teacher completion.

safety_and_reset.truth_information: Only two RGB views, proprioceptive TCP/finger state and static task instruction become pi05 model input. No object pose, precise slot errors, teacher waypoint, Progress stage/progress or scorer result.
safety_and_reset.inference_pause: Episode/step/simulation_time must remain identical across model inference, otherwise reject stale chunk.
safety_and_reset.adapter_reset: Construct new adapter or adapter.reset() at episode boundary; clears episode identity, inference_calls and gripper target. No action queue crosses reset.
safety_and_reset.model_temporal_memory: Installed facade has no reset_session; observed predict path processes present observation independently. Torch RNG is process-global and continues if server reused.
safety_and_reset.seed_support: Server --seed calls torch.manual_seed on construction. Optional per-request inference_seed is supported by server wrapper but stock adapter sends only mode=eval. Environment --seed is separate and does not reseed model.
safety_and_reset.reproducibility_recommendation: Record model startup seed and exact serving schedule. Restart/reseed model per trial if independent per-trial policy seed is required; do not claim environment seed controls model.
